SGPS Statements and Guidance
SGPS Governance
Equity, Diversity, Inclusion, Accessibility, Decolonization, and Indigenization in Graduate Education and Postdoctoral Studies
We recognize Indigenous rights to sovereignty and are committed to having these rights reflected in our mandate, and in policies and procedures that govern graduate education and postdoctoral studies at Western.
Read More
Guidance for the use of Generative AI in Graduate Studies
With ongoing advancements in artificial intelligence (AI), we recognize the need for guidance on the ethical and responsible use of generative AI technologies in graduate work.
Read More
Decolonization and Indigenization in Graduate Education and Postdoctoral Research
We are committed to supporting Indigenous graduate students and fostering respectful, ethical, and community-engaged Indigenous research. This resource brings together policies, procedures, supports, and guidance that help advance Indigenous ways of knowing, remove systemic barriers, and strengthen decolonization and reconciliation efforts within graduate education and postdoctoral research at Western.
